en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a bustling street scene lined with buildings and bare trees. People are walking along the sidewalks and gathering in small groups, dressed in clothing typical of the late 19th or early 20th century. The architecture is European, and the street is lively with activity. The top of the postcard features the text: 'Zemun' and 'Fő-utca — Hauptgasse,' indicating the location and street name in Hungarian and German.
